dedupe_keys.name: chinese provincial hourly electricity load reconstruction 2015 2024

description: The Chinese provincial load team publishes reconstructed hourly electricity demand for 31 provincial-level regions from 2015 through 2024. One Figshare Excel workbook holds ten year sheets and a sheet of heating and cooling power coefficients. The article says the estimates combine limited public load statistics with hourly temperature, wind, solar irradiance and humidity observations. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The tables can provide load-shape inputs or validation targets for national power-system simulations using a model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that the hourly series are reconstructed from weather and sparse published statistics; they are not utility metering for every province. Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are outside coverage. Province labels, timestamps and peak scaling need checking before network aggregation. Own metadata and the Data Records section were read without opening the workbook or checking fit against reported load.
